reviews.text:
This is a fantastic hospital!!

The doctors, staff, and receptionists are incredibly kind and work together as a team!!

The doctors explain things in detail and use easy-to-understand language, making it very easy to understand and approachable. I'm still very grateful for their help.

The staff and receptionists were also very attentive to my cat's health during her hospitalization, noticing even the slightest changes.

Whenever I asked questions, the doctors, staff, and receptionists answered clearly, thoughtfully, and with genuine care. I felt completely satisfied and confident in this hospital.

I'm so glad I was able to take my cat to this hospital, and I'm incredibly grateful for their help in saving my cat.

I was seen here when my regular doctor was closed. The doctor was a very kind young man. He listened carefully to what I had to say and explained everything clearly and thoroughly after the examination. The receptionist was also very pleasant. It's a good hospital that you can feel at ease in.

My two-month-old puppy had diarrhea and a poor appetite, so I took him to the vet for the first time.

The young vet who examined him was very thorough and explained his condition and treatment plan clearly, which put me at ease. The reception staff were also very polite, making it a very pleasant hospital.

Tests revealed that my puppy had intestinal parasites, so we had to continue taking him for checkups. Because I felt the vet was so kind and trustworthy, I now also bring my other pets, a Golden Retriever and a cat, here.

There's a paid parking lot right behind the hospital, which makes it easy to get there by car.

This is a veterinary hospital I feel confident entrusting my dogs and cats to in the future.

The vet was very kind and explained everything thoroughly during the vaccination, and they were also very gentle during the grooming! I was relieved to see that my dog ​​seemed happy at the pet hotel as well.

This clinic is a branch of EST Animal Hospital, and because it's close to my home, I took my cat, who was suffering from gingivitis, there for an examination.
The explanation was easy to understand, even for a layperson, and I was able to implement it immediately.
My cat is quite mischievous, but the doctor's love for animals is evident, and I felt completely at ease entrusting her to him!
My first impression was that the staff were kind and the hospital was easy to visit.

Less than a month after the initial visit, my cat suddenly became ill. I wanted to minimize her suffering, so I took her back to this hospital, where she underwent a thorough examination, and it turned out to be an emergency.
They coordinated with the main hospital and immediately arranged for surgery. On the day of the surgery, I saw the doctor waiting outside for my cat's arrival, and I felt that he was truly worried about my cat, who couldn't express her pain or suffering in words.

Even though I visited frequently after the surgery, he never showed any displeasure and explained her progress in detail.

When I asked about treatment methods for each change in her condition, he explained everything carefully, and his answers were accurate and easy to understand, so I had no anxiety during her hospitalization. Since I have multiple pets, I also requested a health checkup for another one of them. Even though this pet usually dislikes being held by anyone other than me, it was held without any hesitation... Perhaps it's an animal instinct that makes it feel safe to entrust itself to this person.

The veterinarian is young, but has a wonderful personality and creates a comfortable atmosphere that makes it easy to ask questions.

I was originally a patient at the main hospital, and I visited this branch when I heard they opened.

The doctor is very kind and talks to my pet a lot.

The explanations were thorough, and they also gave me detailed instructions on how to treat my pet at home.

They listen attentively to what I have to say, so I feel very at ease leaving my pet in their care.

Thank you, Dr. Uesugi and the nurses, for the thorough and caring examination.

The doctor is very kind, approachable, and easy to talk to.
The hospital is clean, and the ability to register from home is convenient.
However, the fees seem too high compared to the hospital I used to go to...
Aside from the price, it's a 5-star rating!!

My dog ​​has sensitive skin and I had been going to other hospitals, but it wasn't getting any better, so I was worried. Then I found out that this clinic was opening nearby, so I went to consult with them. The reception staff were all smiling and welcoming, and the doctor was also very kind. He listened carefully to what I had to say and explained everything clearly and thoroughly. They suggested a treatment plan that suited my dog ​​and met my wishes, and his skin, which had been getting worse, has improved dramatically. I would like to continue using their services. They also have a grooming salon in the clinic, and I tried their shampoo and herbal pack. My dog's fur became fluffy and his skin condition improved, so I would like to go there regularly.

I attended a teeth-brushing workshop yesterday. The instructor owns the same breed of dog as me, and was happy to answer all my questions and provide helpful advice. I hope to continue receiving their services for a long time to come.

The instructor is very cheerful and enthusiastic, which makes me feel at ease when I go there.
The teacher is very enthusiastic and kind, so I feel at ease.

This was my first time using this hospital, and I truly believe it's an excellent hospital.

I felt a deep love for animals from everyone, from the doctor to the reception staff. The doctor was very kind and thorough, and their explanations were easy to understand, which put me at ease.

I plan to continue using their services for many years to come.

I visited the clinic because my dog ​​had a lump on its stomach.
The doctor was cheerful and kind throughout the visit, and explained everything very clearly to me, the owner.
When I called to inquire about something I had forgotten to ask, they responded very politely. I had mentioned that my dog ​​was lethargic, which worried them, but they called the next day to check on him.
Furthermore, when the test results came back, they contacted me before I even had a chance to visit, to ease my anxiety. They were incredibly polite and attentive in every situation, to the point where I felt almost embarrassed.
Of course, the doctor is also very kind to dogs. During the examination, they spoke to my dog ​​gently and praised him a lot, so I felt completely at ease leaving him in their care.
This time, I happened to visit on a Sunday, and I'm really grateful that they're open on weekends. Also, the app allows you to wait in line, which makes it easy to manage waiting times and is very convenient.
This is a very trustworthy animal hospital that I can visit with peace of mind.
I would like to continue using their services with confidence.

My dog's urine suddenly turned upside down when our usual vet was closed.

Despite the sudden visit, you examined him very carefully, and I am truly grateful.

Since my dog ​​has a history of recurrent bladder stones, I was very worried that it might be a urethral obstruction, but it turned out to be a temporary inflammation, which was a great relief.

At the time, he was already unwell and very weak, but he has gradually recovered since then.

Although some time has passed since the examination, I feel very reassured to have found a vet I can trust in situations like this.

I wanted to post this update and express my gratitude.

Thank you so much, doctor and reception staff, for your prompt and warm response.

I will definitely contact you again if anything comes up.

I was a little worried about my cat's health, so I took her in for her first consultation. It's close to my home, and most importantly, it helps reduce my cat's stress. I thought I'd give it a try. The reception staff greeted me with wonderful smiles, which immediately put me at ease. I felt that the doctor was a person full of love for animals. The examination was very thorough, and the explanations were easy to understand. I think it's a hospital where I can entrust my cat with peace of mind. I will definitely come again ♡

This is a branch of EST Animal Hospital located in Higashinari Ward.

My pet suddenly became ill, so I took him to this branch, which is close to my home, for the first time.

I was very anxious because my family member, who cannot speak, was in a bad state, but the receptionist greeted me with a kind smile, which put me at ease.

The doctor was even more cheerful 😊

The doctor's explanation of the symptoms and medication was clear and easy to understand, and I felt confident entrusting my pet to them.

I'm glad that they share medical records with the main hospital, so even though my pet is at risk, I can take him to a hospital close to home!

This is a newly opened animal hospital, so the interior is very clean, cute, and a very calming space. Initially, I came here because it was close to my home, but the doctor is really kind and thorough, and always takes good care of my pets (I've been here more than three times now), which I'm very grateful for and happy about. The doctor explained everything clearly, from the test results to the neutering surgery and periodontal disease, and the surgery was completed successfully. The wound healed very cleanly and quickly, and their teeth are now sparkling white. The reception staff are also kind and speak to us with heartfelt sincerity, leaving a very good impression, so I feel confident entrusting my pets to this hospital. I look forward to continuing to entrust my pets U^ェ^U to your care.

We requested a neutering surgery.

The surgical scar was very clean, and our dog didn't seem bothered by the wound even after the stitches were removed.

Also, the explanations were thorough and easy to understand, and they patiently answered our repeated questions without showing any annoyance.

The reception staff and groomers are all very pleasant, making our visits enjoyable.

We will continue to bring our dog here in the future. 🐶

I visited this new veterinary clinic for the first time because it opened nearby, and I was so touched by how polite and kind the receptionist and the doctor were (;;). I'm so happy to have found a veterinary clinic that I want to continue taking my pet to (*^^*)

A Chihuahua and a Toy Poodle were reunited with their vet after five years. They were nervous at first, but gradually got used to him and seemed to remember him. Five years ago, the Toy Poodle had urinary stones, but it was detected early and the surgery was successful. The vet is thorough in his examinations and provides clear explanations. The Chihuahua also lost her appetite while the Toy Poodle was hospitalized, so the vet gave both of them IV fluids at the same time; he's a very caring vet. Now that they are seniors, we can consult with him about various things, including their diet, so we can live with peace of mind.

I visited this clinic for the first time because my Chihuahua's vaccinations and triglyceride levels were extremely high 😱. The doctor explained everything very clearly, gave my dog ​​a comprehensive examination, and was very attentive. I also got the blood test results today. The reception staff were kind, they also offer grooming services, and the clinic is very clean. The doctor is handsome too 😊
